Conclusion: The test `test_margins_casted_to_float` checks whether the `pd.pivot_table` function correctly handles margins and data types in a DataFrame. However, the test failure indicates that the resulting DataFrame has columns with incorrect data types. Specifically, column "C" is of type `int64`, while it should be `float64`. The root cause of this issue lies within the implementation of the `pd.pivot_table` function.

To fix this bug, you would need to ensure that the margins are properly cast to the appropriate data type when computing the pivot table. This can be achieved by modifying the code snippet where margins are calculated and ensuring that all relevant columns have their data types correctly set.

Here are the methods that would be best locations to be fixed:

```
pandas.core.reshape.pivot_table.PivotTableAgg.<init>(self, values, index, columns, aggfunc, margins)
pandas.core.reshape.pivot_table.PivotTableAgg._sum(self, values)
pandas.core.reshape.pivot_table.PivotTableAgg._count(self, values)
```
